title: Predicts Types of Variables
text: goal Typerclass predict type variables (nominal, ordinal, scale) based empirical distribution observed values. Numeric variables processed probabilistic prediction model. numeric inputs, typerclass analyzes empirical distribution observed values returns: predicted measurement type (.pred_class) estimated probabilities class: .pred_N (Nominal) .pred_O (Ordinal) .pred_S (Scale) predicted class corresponds measurement level highest estimated probability. Variables type factor first converted numeric processed probabilistic prediction model. Variables type logical, character, date excluded probabilistic prediction model. variables deterministically classified Nominal, since measurement level inferred empirical numeric distribution. variables: .pred_class set N (Nominal) .pred_N, .pred_O, .pred_S returned NA Variables types (e.g. complex, list) processed prediction results returned NA output fields.

title: Predict measurement types for dataset variables — predict_type
text: Computes distributional metrics numeric variables uses pretrained random-forest model classify variable nominal (N), ordinal (O), scale (S). Non-numeric variables handled deterministically: character/logical variables marked nominal, date variables ordinal, unsupported types receive empty predictions.
